gaps: Every breath-one attractor was a property of the node, a speed, a floor, a name, a reputation, or a position the node holds. Testing each against the pointer's live question, what a second node does, split them three ways nothing in the node's properties predicted: copying the registry annihilated both copies, copying the fast payer left each intact, and copying the incumbent bank produced a node with none of the incumbent's flow because the attractor sat in the pair. This produced the changed question for breath two: where the attractor lives.
accepted: Room where comparisons happen: the keeper of Lloyd's underwriting floor, the spot market at the port, the saleroom hosts the operation of comparing, and each side comes because the other side is already there, so deals arrive as a byproduct of the comparison; the keeper pays in neutrality, since a room whose keeper trades on what it sees empties, and in the upkeep of liquidity; it decays when comparison moves elsewhere, and a second room does not split the flow evenly but thins both until one tips, since a comparison of half the market is worth less than half; not Forty jewelers, where the compared parties are themselves the attractor, since here the byproduct goes to the host.

Counterparty of last resort: the pawnbroker, the scrap yard, the salvage buyer, the central bank's window says yes to anything at some price, so flow bends there from two directions, the rejected and the certainty-seeking; it costs the capital to take whatever comes and the adverse selection of receiving what everyone else declined, and it decays on a single no, since always is gone the first time it is not true; on copying the always is conserved and the last is not, as two floors are a market and neither is last; not the whole-carcass buyer, who refuses the half, since this one takes any size at its price.

Tollgate that may not buy: when every deal in a class must pass one desk, the notary, the land registry, the title company, the port pilot, that desk sees every deal first without anyone sending it, and the same compulsion that grants the sight forbids the seat, since a registry that traded on what it registered would lose the rule that makes passage compulsory; it costs the franchise and the conflict rules that keep it, it decays by bypass, and a second registry does not halve the flow but unmakes both, because a title recorded in two books is recorded in neither; not leverage-discoveries' identity register, which is about what a small edit there moves, since here the question is what the desk may do with what it sees.

Cheap probe: the dealer who quotes on anything within the hour, the investor who says no in a day and never gossips, is shown everything first because a showing costs the sender nothing, so first refusal arrives by default; it costs answering everything, including junk, fast and silently, and it decays the day a no costs the sender something, a leak, a sulk, a delay; a threshold, so conserved on copying, though the first showing goes to whichever probe is cheapest that morning; not the last resort, since the probe says no more often than anyone.

Retrade-free close: the buyer known never to reprice after the handshake, the publisher who pays on signature, the cash buyer of the house lets sellers accept a lower price for a higher probability, so flow bends toward certainty and the certainty is paid for in the spread; it costs closing the deals one has come to regret, and it decays on one public retrade; conserved on copying, since two reliable closers are both reliable, while the discount each earns is competed away; not paying in speed, which is latency, since a certain closer may be slow.

Name others need: the anchor tenant, the lead investor, the marquee chef in the food hall receives deals because the rest of the deal cannot close without its participation, so its name is an input the other parties must procure; the name is valuable only while scarce, so the cost is every deal it declines to lend itself to, and it decays by over-lending, since a name on everything certifies nothing; positional, with the count of positions conserved rather than the holder, so a second name splits the flow while each still receives it; not the scarce coin of exchange-ontologies, which the seller wants for itself, since here the name is wanted for third parties.

Paying in speed: the factor, the same-day scrap buyer, the insurer that settles claims in two days draws every seller with a time preference, and the seller pays for the speed in price; it costs a float and the risk of paying before verifying, and it decays the day it slows; a threshold, so conserved on copying; not certainty, since the fast payer may haggle at the gate, and the seller who needs the money by Friday will take that.

Holder of the next lot: the neighbor who owns the adjoining parcel, the firm holding the complementary patent, the pipeline beside the gas field is the highest-value buyer by construction, and sellers who know the assembly premium bring the lot there first; the position costs the carry of the asset that makes it and the premium it invites, since the seller charges the adjacency the holder created, and it decays when the assembly completes or the adjacency stops mattering; the position cannot be copied, though the lot's other neighbors each hold their own; not first-mover-forecloses' acquisition of a bottleneck, which is a move, since this is what holding a position does to what arrives.

Public loser: the underbidder in a famous sale has broadcast, free and credibly, an appetite, a capacity, and a reservation price within one bid of exact, so the next comparable asset is walked to its door; the cost was paid in the lost deal's diligence and continues as anchoring, since every seller now prices to the leaked ceiling, and it decays by clock as the appetite is presumed filled elsewhere; singular by history, since no copy lost that deal; not the habitual bidder, whose continuous signal is discounted precisely because it cost nothing.

Whole-carcass buyer: the farmer sells the animal to the restaurant that takes all of it, the liquidator takes the whole store, the reinsurer the whole treaty, because the seller's cost of fragmenting the sale routes the whole to whoever can take the whole; it costs a balance sheet sized to the lot and decays as the sheet shrinks; a threshold rather than a rank, so a second buyer able to take the whole leaves the first's flow intact and competes only the price; not the last resort, which takes any size at its price, since this buyer refuses the half.

residue.item: Posted bid: a standing published price to buy a named thing, the scrap yard's board, the coin dealer's buy list, so the seller's first move is a sale rather than an inquiry.
residue.why: Rejected: a posted price is a price, not a bending; where it bends flow it does so as a floor (Counterparty of last resort) or as a reference other deals are struck against, and the brief excludes jargon and prices standing in for mechanisms.

residue.item: Invited eye: the appraiser, surveyor, or inspector hired into every deal in a class sees each one and may act afterward.
residue.why: Merged into Tollgate that may not buy: the same sight-without-seat and the same decay the instant the eye acts, since nobody hires an inspector who competes; compulsory versus invited passage did not change what the position may do with what it sees.

residue.item: Habitual bidder: the party present at every auction whether buying or not, so it is on every list.
residue.why: Merged into Public loser as the low-dose version of the same appetite signal; kept as its discriminator, since a continuous signal that cost nothing is discounted and the famous loss is credible precisely because it was paid for.

residue.item: Standard form: the party whose contract template everyone drafts on, so deals arrive pre-shaped to its terms.
residue.why: Rejected: the template routes deals to every party that accepts the form, not to its author; it shapes deals without bending them toward a node.

residue.item: Dry powder: known to have money now, the fund that just raised.
residue.why: Rejected: decomposes into Public loser (capacity broadcast credibly) and Retrade-free close (capacity that will not fail at signing); no new bending beyond those two.

gate: declared modality, recognizable distinction, defensible seriation and conditional relations
limits: Authored conceptual fieldwork, not an empirical taxonomy or a partition; a real node runs several attractors at once, and the list makes no claim to cover every way flow bends.

The seriation is an itinerary of what a second node does to each attractor, not a ranking of strength, value, or ease; the copy-behavior claims are authored reasoning about mechanisms, not measurements.

The illustrative cases (Lloyd's floor, Hatton Garden, title registries, chilling by rights of first refusal, nose-to-tail carcass sales, night bondsmen) are simplified to expose one mechanism each and are not claims about the specific histories.

Adjacent lists are not restated: deal-flow-sources lists where flow comes from, leverage-discoveries lists positions where small inputs have large effects, first-mover-forecloses lists moves; where an item touches one, its discriminator says what it adds. Flow that is hunted, by outreach, advertising, or salience bought with spend, is outside by construction.

Selection effects on the attracted flow are noted only where they are part of an attractor's cost (adverse selection at the last resort, anchoring against the public loser); what volume does to a node's criteria is deal-flow-reflexivities' territory and is left out.

gaps: The changed question yielded an attractor in the edge (The open file), one in the copies themselves (Forty jewelers), one in a contract that compels the offer rather than the passage (Written first look), one in the deal's own need not to be seen (Confessional), one in time rather than structure (Awake at the hour), and two more locations of the certainty a seller buys (Still here next harvest, Named in the no). The territory pointer 'deal-flow attractors' stands and the slug is kept; the of-sentence now names the four locations, and the seriation axis is the pointer's live question made into an itinerary. The remote-domain probes (beehive quorum, monastery guesthouse, prison store man) dissolved into existing members or residue rather than adding one: the hive's dance is the room's tipping, the guesthouse is a last resort, the store man is enforcement and out.
accepted: The open file: the next deal goes to whoever the counterparty need not onboard, the incumbent bank for the next loan, the vendor already in procurement, the insurer already holding the file, so the attractor lives in the edge between two parties rather than in the node; it costs keeping the file open, compliance and vendor status and a champion who remembers, and it decays when procurement resets or the champion leaves; a copy of the node is not onboarded, so per pair the attractor is not conserved, while across the market the class of open files is; not ghost-leverages' toll at a gate with a free bypass, since the onboarding the file saves is a real cost.

Forty jewelers: Hatton Garden's jewelers, the booksellers' street, the auto mile draw flow to each member because buyers come to compare many at once, so a lone jeweler on a quiet street receives less than one of forty and the attractor is the copies themselves; it costs the rent of the district and being compared, and it decays when comparison moves to a host that lists them all; strengthened by copying up to congestion, so it is the one attractor for which one is the only number that does not work; not the room, whose keeper hosts the comparison, since here each node is one of the compared.

Written first look: a right of first refusal, a pre-emption clause, a tenant's option makes the offer compulsory rather than the passage, so the one deal the paper names must be shown to the holder before anyone else; paid for in the earlier deal that wrote it, it expires with the paper and decays sooner by chilling, since other bidders will not spend diligence on a deal the holder can match; it cannot be copied, as two first looks are a queue and not two firsts; not the tollgate, which sees every deal and may take none, since the holder may take the one deal it sees.

Confessional: the private bank, the lawyer under privilege, the dealer known to keep the seller's name off the sale draws the deals that cannot be seen, since the seller's cost of being seen routes the deal to the node that cannot tell; it costs never telling, even when telling would win the next deal, and it decays on one leak; conserved on copying; not the room, whose attraction is exactly the visibility this node must lack.

Awake at the hour: the bail bondsman, the tow truck, the night pharmacist takes the deal because at the instant of need the searcher's horizon collapses to whoever answers, and no comparison happens; it costs someone always awake and decays on one unanswered call; a bottleneck in time rather than in structure, and unlike the registry it survives copying, since each caller at three in the morning still meets one node; not leverage-discoveries' bottleneck hour, which is about the power of the scarce input, since here it is the searcher's horizon.

Still here next harvest: a deal with a tail, a warranty, a royalty, an earnout, a buyback, prices the counterparty's survival into its terms, so the author chooses the press that keeps the backlist in print and the grower sells to the co-op that will exist next season; it costs visible durability, reserves and age that can be seen, and it decays on any sign of mortality; conserved on copying; not the retrade-free close, whose certainty ends at closing, since here the certainty is for what comes after.

Named in the no: when the party that declines a deal says whom to try instead, the refusers become an unpaid funnel, and flow bends toward the workout shop, the salvage-title buyer, the contractor who finishes other contractors' jobs without any of them being approached; it costs being known to the refusers and taking the flow they filtered against, and it decays when the refusers start keeping what they used to send, or forget the name; a second such node must be named too, so the split is by the referrer's memory rather than the seller's choice; not the last resort, which the seller knew about before asking anyone, since here the seller learns the destination at the moment of refusal.

Shelf that draws both sides: the dealer with stock is where buyers go, and sellers, reading the stock as evidence of buyers, bring their goods to the full shop rather than the empty one, so inventory pulls in the direction opposite to what its carrying cost suggests; the loop runs on carry, decays when the stock goes stale, and reverses by itself once the shelf empties, since an empty shelf tells sellers there are no buyers and so stays empty; a second dealer splits both sides and the fuller shelf draws faster; speculative in the inference attributed to sellers, observed in the full shop's unsolicited offers; not the room, which holds nothing, since here the stock is the pivot.

residue.item: First name recalled: the sender who does not compare brings the deal to the one name it can produce without searching, the gold buyer from the television.
residue.why: Rejected: the recall was bought with advertising, so the flow was hunted at one remove; the brief's territory is flow that bends instead of being hunted, and the boundary case now says so.

residue.item: Heir of the book: when a dealer dies or retires, the flow that was sticky to that person seeks the nearest resemblance, the apprentice or the named successor.
residue.why: Unresolved seed: the bending is The open file transferred by inheritance, so it adds no new location for the attractor; what is interesting is that flow has momentum and conserves itself by finding a successor, which belongs to a map about how flow moves between nodes rather than why it bends toward one.

residue.item: One who can collect: in a market without courts, flow bends to whoever can enforce, the store man in the prison economy, the bourse that can expel.
residue.why: Rejected: enforcement as a stabilizer belongs to cooperation-mechanisms, and where it bends flow it is bundled into Room where comparisons happen, since the diamond bourse's expulsion is part of what the room's keeper maintains.

residue.item: Scarce coin: the node that pays in a currency the seller can get nowhere else, the credit on the film, the place on the menu.
residue.why: Rejected: exchange-ontologies carries the coin, and the bending reduces to Name others need in the case where the coin is the node's name; a coin wanted for itself rather than for third parties did not survive as a distinct location of the attractor.

neighbors.left: Retrade-free close: the buyer known never to reprice after the handshake, the publisher who pays on signature, the cash buyer of the house lets sellers accept a lower price for a higher probability, so flow bends toward certainty and the certainty is paid for in the spread; it costs closing the deals one has come to regret, and it decays on one public retrade; conserved on copying, since two reliable closers are both reliable, while the discount each earns is competed away; not paying in speed, which is latency, since a certain closer may be slow.
neighbors.right: Paying in speed: the factor, the same-day scrap buyer, the insurer that settles claims in two days draws every seller with a time preference, and the seller pays for the speed in price; it costs a float and the risk of paying before verifying, and it decays the day it slows; a threshold, so conserved on copying; not certainty, since the fast payer may haggle at the gate, and the seller who needs the money by Friday will take that.
neighbors.separating_case: A municipal buyer that always pays and never reprices, but in ninety days, against a scrap dealer at the gate who pays cash on the spot and haggles when he sees the load: the seller who needs the money to exist goes to the municipality, the seller who needs it by Friday goes to the gate. Certainty and latency are priced separately, and a node can hold either attractor without the other.

checks.boundary_case: Sheer size is out: a big node with no floor, no speed, no name, and no open file receives nothing unbidden, as the conglomerate nobody pitches shows; size is a precondition for several attractors (the whole carcass, the last resort) but bends no flow by itself. Also out by construction is the name that is recalled first because it was advertised: recall bought with spend is the hunt at one remove, not a bending.
checks.form_inference: The map shows a fork the sequence conceals: Room where comparisons happen and Confessional sit ten places apart on the itinerary, but the edge says they are the two branches of one seller's decision and no node can be both. It shows a passage between levels at Forty jewelers → Room where comparisons happen, where the compared become the host's supply, and the same passage repeats one level up when hosts are compared. It shows a loop at Written first look → Counterparty of last resort, where a contract at the annihilated end of the axis chills the field and drops its holder into the split middle as the only bidder. It shows two incompatibilities, Counterparty of last resort → Shelf that draws both sides (never refuse against curate) and Name others need → Public loser (an anchor cannot afford to be seen losing). And it shows a dependency, Cheap probe → Named in the no, since a refusal that carries a name presupposes a refusal cheap enough to be asked for.
checks.target_preserved: Self-read only. Each admitted item names a distinct reason flow arrives unbidden, a distinct upkeep, a distinct decay, and a distinct fate under copying; the strange members (a bottleneck that may not buy, a loss that attracts, a shelf that pulls sellers, a district whose attractor is its rivals, a contract that empties the field it bends) are kept as mechanisms rather than softened into advice about reputation.

next_crossfield_opening: Attractors that live in the pair rather than the node: connect The open file with witness-architectures' Arm's-length custody and traces-of-the-unlived's carriers; ask which deal-flow attractors are records held by someone other than the node, and whether an attractor held in another party's file can be transferred, inherited, or destroyed without the node doing anything.

gaps: Tollgate that may not buy anchored the axis as the annihilated end, yet two of its four cases (notary, title company) are compulsory classes copied in thousands that split on copying like the fast payer; the item bundled the singular desk, which a copy unmakes, with the class of desks, which belongs in the conserved stretch. The sight-without-seat mechanism and the axis survive; the class cases moved into the discriminator. Next most wrong: the fork edge's 'no node can hold both attractors', falsified by every auction house that runs a saleroom and a private-sales desk; the fork is per deal, and a node wanting both must wall them.
accepted: Tollgate that may not buy: when every deal in a class must pass one desk, the land registry, the port's pilotage association, the exchange's sole clearinghouse, that desk sees every deal first without anyone sending it, and the same compulsion that grants the sight forbids the seat, since a registry that traded on what it registered would lose the rule that makes passage compulsory; it costs the franchise and the conflict rules that keep it, it decays by bypass, and a second registry does not halve the flow but unmakes both, because a title recorded in two books is recorded in neither; not the notary or the title company, which every deal must pass but not this one, since a compulsory class of desks splits on copying like the fast payer and only the singular desk is unmade by its copy; not leverage-discoveries' identity register, which is about what a small edit there moves, since here the question is what the desk may do with what it sees.

Room where comparisons happen: the keeper of Lloyd's underwriting floor, the spot market at the port, the saleroom hosts the operation of comparing, and each side comes because the other side is already there, so deals arrive as a byproduct of the comparison; the keeper pays in neutrality, or in dealing that is walled and disclosed, since a room whose keeper is believed to trade against what it sees empties, and the auction house that guarantees lots keeps its floor only by publishing that it does, and in the upkeep of liquidity; it decays when comparison moves elsewhere, and a second room does not split the flow evenly but thins both until one tips, since a comparison of half the market is worth less than half; not Forty jewelers, where the compared parties are themselves the attractor, since here the byproduct goes to the host.

residue.item: Counterparty of last resort: 'decays on a single no'
residue.why: Kept as written at the critic's own ruling; the line is an aphorism carried as mechanism (the always is always within the class the node claimed, and pawnbrokers refuse outside it daily), too good to domesticate, so the reading is recorded in the record's mode rather than edited into the item.

residue.item: Name others need → Public loser: 'the anchor bids only where it will win'
residue.why: Kept at the critic's ruling as authored behavioral speculation; the incompatibility is a real claim but a lead investor seen losing a contested round is not visibly diminished, so the modality is recorded in mode rather than the edge cut.

residue.item: Critic's boundary ruling that the of-sentence should state its implicit clause, 'an attractor bends flow toward a node at a price the seller would not otherwise accept'
residue.why: Offered from the boundary probe, not as a repair; the of-sentence is left as authored, and the clause is carried in target_preserved so a reader meets it beside the gate rather than in a rewritten title.

residue.item: Seriation reorder for The open file
residue.why: The critic asked that the copy-inert station be named, not that the item move; it already sits between Named in the no and Whole-carcass buyer, so the axis statement now names the station and the order is unchanged.

limits: Edges relabeled: Room → Confessional now makes the incompatibility per sale, with a node that offers both walling them; Written first look → Counterparty of last resort now has the seller facing the holder as a floor while the holder keeps the right to refuse, and form_inference names it a one-way passage rather than a loop; Name others need → Cheap probe now conditions the decay on the over-lent name still answering fast and quietly. Room where comparisons happen's neutrality is conditioned on disclosed, walled dealing. No items cut, none added; the seed below is the missing member.
seed: The tollgate that must buy: compulsory cession to the national reinsurer, the union hiring hall, the procurement set-aside, the state's pre-emptive right over antiquities leaving the country. Flow compelled by rule toward a node that may and must take the seat, at every deal in the class rather than the one deal the paper names. It sits between Tollgate that may not buy and Written first look on the axis, costs the obligation to take the class's worst risks plus the political franchise, decays with the statute, and splits by quota on copying. The map's first two items are its two halves, sight without seat and seat for one deal, and the whole is missing; it would also carry the of-sentence's implicit clause into the open, since here the seller's price is set by rule rather than accepted.
